cases.purpose: Load and remove the real xz-compressed nbd module with parameters through non-dry modprobe
cases.oracle: Kernel module inventory and nbd sysfs parameters
cases.comparison: Successful transition and parameter value, followed by removal; missing kernel decompression support or preloaded nbd is a prerequisite failure
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t bashkmod) == builtin ]] || exit 125
has() { local n; while read -r n _; do [[ $n == nbd ]] && return 0; done </proc/modules; return 1; }
has && exit 125
path=$(/usr/sbin/modinfo -n nbd) || exit 125
[[ $path == *.ko.xz ]] || exit 125
[[ -r /sys/module/compression && $(</sys/module/compression) == xz ]] || exit 125
cleanup() { if has; then /usr/sbin/rmmod nbd || exit 1; fi; }
trap cleanup EXIT
bashkmod modprobe nbd nbds_max=4 || exit 1
has || exit 1
[[ $(</sys/module/nbd/parameters/nbds_max) == 4 ]] || exit 1
bashkmod modprobe -r nbd || exit 1
has && exit 1
echo 'compressed transition and parameters: ok'
